description: Remove one of your own layers projects. The picture it came from and any picture you flattened from it stay in your library. Call it first without confirm: it says exactly what would be removed and changes nothing. Then, once the person agrees, call again with confirm true. Free.

confirm.description: Leave it out first: the answer says exactly what would be removed. Set true only after the person agrees.
